# Paths owned by the Commercial distribution rather than inherited verbatim.
# "preserve" restores the file from Commercial main after a Personal merge.
# "delete" keeps a Personal-only path absent from Commercial.
preserve .github/CODEOWNERS
preserve .github/pull_request_template.md
preserve .github/workflows/ci.yml
preserve .github/workflows/release.yml
delete .github/workflows/personal-source-availability.yml
preserve README.md
